## Games

### Veolia Towers Hamburg edge out Phoenix Hagen in thriller

*Played Sunday, 22 November 2026* *(updated with new sources)*

Veolia Towers Hamburg won a closely contested game 97:94 against Phoenix Hagen, with Jahvon Blair scoring 27 points, including six three-pointers, to lead the team. Osaro Rich set a new personal best with 17 points and became the Veolia Towers' record holder for most games played, surpassing Lukas Meisner's 155 games. The game was a high-scoring affair with 12 lead changes in the second half, and both teams struggled to gain a significant advantage. Chris Harris, Phoenix Hagen's coach, praised the Veolia Towers' speed, athleticism, and rebounding, saying they presented significant problems for his team. Benka Barloschky, Veolia Towers' coach, credited his team's ability to conserve energy and praised Harris's creative playstyle. The win was a crucial one for Veolia Towers, who will head into the national team break with momentum, while Phoenix Hagen will look to regroup and improve for their next game.

### Bonn Dominates Ulm 89-72 in Home Win

*Played Sunday, 22 November 2026*

The Telekom Baskets Bonn secured their sixth consecutive win with a dominant 89-72 victory over ratiopharm ulm at home. Marcus Foster led the team with 16 points, followed by John-Michael Wright with 13 and Jeff Garrett and Joel Aminu with 10 points each. The Baskets' strong team performance saw them distribute 20 assists and lose the ball only 11 times. Jeff Garrett also reached a milestone with 1,500 points in his easyCredit Basketball Bundesliga career. The win keeps the Baskets' perfect November record intact, with all their games won in the month. The team will now enter the FIBA break, with captain Michael Kessens representing Germany in the World Cup qualifiers and co-trainer Lionel Bosco coaching Belgium in the EuroBasket qualifiers.

## Around the League

### Bamberg Baskets Seek to Break Attendance Record in DBBL Pokal

The Bamberg Baskets women's team is preparing for a highlight of the season on December 5, when they host the reigning German champion, Rutronik Stars Keltern, in the DBBL Pokal. The team is encouraging fans to attend the game, which is expected to be a sell-out, with over 300 tickets already sold. The Baskets are aiming to break the attendance record in the Graf-Stauffenberg-Halle, which currently stands at 708. The team is promoting the game as a special event, with the Orange Day game against Jena taking place the previous Sunday.

Sources:

- [Bamberg Baskets: LASST UNS DEN REKORD KNACKEN! | Bamberg Baskets](https://www.bamberg.basketball/news/lasst-uns-den-rekord-knacken)

### Medikamente per Klick Bamberg Baskets Suffer Heavy Defeat in Heidelberg

Medikamente per Klick Bamberg Baskets suffered a 82-50 defeat at the hands of USC BasCats Heidelberg in the Toyota 2. Damen Basketball Bundesliga. The loss was a significant blow to the Bambergerinnen, who were already struggling with the absence of starting point guard Emma Rettinger due to a cruciate ligament injury. The team's problems were compounded by the additional loss of Elise Tweedie, who was also absent from the game. The Heidelbergerinnen, led by coach Niko Kuusi, dominated the game from start to finish, with Leni Schramm-Bünning and Jackie Grisdale emerging as the top scorers with 14 points each. The Bambergerinnen struggled to keep up with the Heidelbergerinnen's pace, particularly in the rebounding department, where they were outdone 32-54. The loss leaves the Bambergerinnen with a 2-1 record, while the Heidelbergerinnen take sole possession of the top spot in the standings with a 3-0 record.

Sources:

- [Bamberg Baskets: Dezimierte Medikamente per Klick Bamberg Baskets unterliegen in Heidelberg | Bamberg Baskets](https://www.bamberg.basketball/news/dezimierte-medikamente-per-klick-bamberg-baskets-unterliegen-in-heidelberg)

### Seawolves Women Extend Winning Streak to Five

The Rostock Seawolves Women's team extended their winning streak to five games with a 82-52 victory over BG Zehlendorf. They remain undefeated at the top of the 1. Regionalliga Nord table. The team's coach, Andrea Hoferichter, praised her players, saying she was 'very proud' of them and that they had shown 'a lot of energy' on the court. Hoferichter also noted that her team had built a 35-point lead and that five players had scored in double figures, with Paula Puzule leading the way with 23 points. In other news, the Seawolves Academy team lost 78-87 to Itzehoe Eagles in the BARMER 2. Basketball Bundesliga ProB Nord, with Isayah Owens and Nigel Pruitt combining for 39 points.

Sources:

- [Rostock Seawolves: Frauen gewinnen 5. Spiel in Folge](https://www.seawolves.de/frauen-gewinnen-5-spiel-in-folge)

### ALBA Berlin Youth Teams Enjoy Successful Weekend

ALBA Berlin's youth teams had a successful weekend in the NBBL, JBBL, WNBL, and wU16 leagues. The NBBL team won 89-82 at home against Hamburg Towers, led by Lukas Klein's 29 points, 24 rebounds, and 2 steals. In the JBBL, ALBA Berlin defeated Hamburg Towers 75-55, with Konrad Terwey scoring 17 points and grabbing 10 rebounds. The WNBL team won 81-47 against TuSLi CITY Berlin, while the wU16 team dominated BG Zehlendorf 106-46. ALBA Berlin's cooperation partners LOK Bernau and TuS Lichterfelde had mixed results, with LOK Bernau winning 47-85 at Hertener Löwen and TuS Lichterfelde losing 50-78 to BBC Osnabrück in the DBBL Nord.
